Exactly 12 bounded web searches completed across all four miss classes; no tool search errors were reported. Searches used a 2–3-day recency filter and explicit 2026-10-26 timing, but results were dominated by older events; crawler or search-index freshness is not treated as incident freshness.

No source identified a U.S. food-access disruption newly reported between 18:49:37 and 19:51:53 PDT on October 26, 2026 with verifiable qualifying access consequences. findings=[] means no confirmed matches, not proof no incidents occurred.

Official SNAP/WIC searches surfaced mainly historic 2025 benefit disruptions; no new first-party October 26, 2026 official interruption with immediate access consequences was verified.
Flood-related Facebook cancellation previously flagged as unverified remains without independent event date/location/source verification; not promoted.
Excluded donation drives, resource guides, routine programs and aid announcements, pet-only food pantries, recipes, generic inflation, stale stories, duplicates, and out-of-country news.
Search-index lag and inaccessible local agency social posts can hide events within a one-hour window; these are routine coverage limitations, not observed failures of this run.
